## PR 750

**Geography map: boundary pack and licence (S29; parked; CN-054; Size M; no dependency) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপ: সীমানার ফাইল (জেলা, থানা) অফলাইনে রিপোজিটরিতে, গ্যাজেটিয়ারের সাথে মেলানো, লাইসেন্স যাচাই করে। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: boundary pack and licence** (S29; **parked**; CN-054; Size M; no dependency) — the map's shapes, offline. A script in `packages/delivery/scripts` turns a licence-clean open boundary source (candidates: geoBoundaries, UN OCHA COD-AB; GADM and OpenStreetMap shapes are not used) into simplified, ready-drawn SVG paths for divisions, districts, upazilas/thanas and Dhaka City thanas, stored in the repository under `packages/delivery/data/geo/` (one small file per level, loaded only when the level is opened; no map library, no tiles, no call out at view time). Each shape is matched to a gazetteer `code` by name and district (the `aliases` of PR 549 carry Gabtali/Gabtoli, Bogra/Bogura); shapes that do not match are listed in a check file for hand fixing, never guessed. The centre of each shape fills `GeoArea.lat/lng` where empty (today none of the 1717 sample places has one, so PR 568's bubble map draws nothing), through the importer's existing path. `LICENSE-NOTICE.md` records source, date and licence; no file enters before the licence is read and confirmed. Tests: every shape matches exactly one place, the size budget per level, no network call. No migration. Risk: high (name matching). Plan: `docs/reports/2026-11-15-geo-map-plan.md` section 3.
- **Filed under:** [S29 · Geography map (Reports) — PR 750–761 (parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked): **Updated 16 Nov 2026 (coded, local branch `claude/geo-1`, NOT pushed, status stays parked until the owner says):** source geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab) release gbOpen, country BGD, simplified GeoJSON of 12 Dec 2023, read from the project's repository; licence per layer: divisions CC0, districts and upazilas CC BY 3.0 IGO (BBS / OCHA ROAP), the project's own work CC BY 4.0; credit written into every pack file; `packages/delivery/data/geo/` holds division.json (8), district.json (64), upazila.json (507), dhakaThana.json (41), centroids.json, unmatched.json (two shapes left for hand fixing: Chittagong Port, Dakshin Sunamganj), hand-fixes.json (23 spelling fixes), LICENSE-NOTICE.md and the source's own metadata; `src/geo-pack.ts` (pure), `src/geo.ts` (reads the files, subpath `@extas/delivery/geo`), `scripts/make-geo-pack.ts` (`pnpm --filter @extas/delivery geo:pack <folder>`); the sample gazetteer's lat/lng are filled for 614 places; whole pack about 0.45 MB; tests `test/geo-pack.pure.test.ts`. Dhaka City areas other than thanas have no shape (pins).
  - [CN-054 (owner asked in chat for a Reports › Geography map; plan only, parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#extas--master-register): Findings that shaped the split: the repository holds no boundary file at all, and none of the 1717 gazetteer places has a latitude or longitude, so today's bubble map draws nothing; boundaries must come from a licence-clean open source, stored in the repository and drawn as plain SVG with no map library and no call out at view time (PR 750).
- **Mentions:** [PR 549](S06.md#pr-549), [PR 568](S16.md#pr-568)

## PR 751

**Geography map: the figures (S29; parked; CN-054; Size M; no dependency) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপ: এলাকা ধরে অর্ডার, বিক্রি, ডেলিভারড, ফেরত, ফেরতের হার আর টপ পণ্য-ক্যাটাগরির হিসাব, দুই সময়ের তুলনা সহ। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: the figures** (S29; **parked**; CN-054; Size M; no dependency) — `geoByArea` in `@extas/metrics`, built on the rules of `salesByArea` (PR 568, the same days and basis): orders placed (by placed day), Sales and Delivered (delivered day, goods = subtotal − discount), Returned (returned day), return rate = returned ÷ (delivered + returned), the top category of every area and, for one area on demand, its top products (pieces, then sales), for any period and, side by side, a second period (previous period, same period last year or own dates), by district, upazila/thana or area, parts adding up to the whole, unknown area counted apart. Read-only, store-scoped, no customer names or phones. Tests on PostgreSQL, including a large sample (about 100,000 orders over 6 months at the upazila level) to measure speed; if it is too slow, a daily roll-up table (additive, filled by the night clock) is filed as its own PR, not built before. No migration, no setting.
- **Filed under:** [S29 · Geography map (Reports) — PR 750–761 (parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked): **Updated 16 Nov 2026 (coded, local branch `claude/geo-1`, NOT pushed, status stays parked until the owner says):** `packages/metrics/src/geo.ts` (`geoByArea`, `geoAreaDetail`), `geo-pure.ts` (compare days, difference of two periods), `geo-types.ts` (the shared shapes; also the subpath `@extas/metrics/geo-types` for client code). Levels division, district, upazila/thana and area (Dhaka City); a drill-down by `parentAreaId`; Orders by the placed day, Delivered and Sales by the delivered day, Returned by the returned day, same rules and same numbers as `salesByArea` (a test checks it); top category per area; top products for one area on demand; the second period previous / last year / own days with a missing area counted as zero; Sales is null without `includeMoney` (books.read) and so is its difference; `belowMinOrders` from the `minOrders` setting; unknown and outside counted apart so parts add up. Without a category or product filter the counts are SQL totals by area (fast); with one, per-order shares like `salesByArea`. Tests: `geo-pure.test.ts` (ran), `geo.db.test.ts` (written, NOT run: no PostgreSQL on the build machine; the 100,000-order speed test runs with GEO_PERF=1). The speed is not measured yet: if it is too slow the roll-up table is filed as its own PR.
- **Mentions:** [PR 568](S16.md#pr-568)

## PR 756

**Geography map: every slice (S29; parked; CN-054, owner's 15 Nov addition; Size M; depends on 751, 752) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপ: সব রকম স্লাইস, যেমন সময়, এলাকার স্তর, পণ্য, চ্যানেল, পেমেন্ট, কুরিয়ার, নতুন বা পুরোনো কাস্টমার, আর দুই সময় তুলনা। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: every slice** (S29; **parked**; CN-054, owner's 15 Nov addition; Size M; depends on 751, 752) — the report is sliced, in any mix, by period (day, month, 6 months, year, custom), area level (division, district, upazila/thana, area), product and category, channel (the order's source), payment type (COD, online), courier, customer type (new or repeat) and, side by side, a second period; the figures of PR 751 take these as filters, the screen of PR 753 shows them in one filter bar (a phone gets them in a sheet), and a saved view can keep a mix (the saved views of PR 689). The list of slices is not a wall of switches: `reports.geoMap.slices` lists which ones show, off ones hidden. Tests: every mix adds up to the whole, an unknown value counts apart. No migration.
- **Filed under:** [S29 · Geography map (Reports) — PR 750–761 (parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked): **Updated 16 Nov 2026 (coded, local branch `claude/geo-2`, NOT pushed, status stays parked until the owner says):** `packages/metrics/src/geo-slices.ts` — the slices as one set (`categoryId`, `productId`, `channel`, `paymentType`, `courierId`, `customerType`): read from the address or a saved view and checked (a bad value is dropped, never trusted), only the ones switched on in `reports.geoMap.slices` allowed, `orderSliceSql` (one SQL filter on the orders: channel = the order's source, payment = cash on delivery / online / other from the payment method, courier = a courier with a live parcel on the order, customer = New when it is the buyer's first order and Repeat when an earlier one exists, an order that cannot say is counted apart and never dropped) and `geoSliceBreakdown` ("Orders by channel, payment, courier or customer": every value that has orders, the parts adding up to the Total line, "Not known" as its own bucket, no Sales column without the money right). Screen parts: `GeoSlicesBar.tsx` (Filters: Channel, Payment, Courier, Customer, Apply, Clear filters; only the slices that are on are drawn; the rest of the address and the screen's own category and product are kept), `GeoSliceTable.tsx` ("Orders by …" with a link per dimension), words in `admin-geo-slices.{en,bn}.json`. No customer name, phone or address is read. Tests: `geo-slices.test.ts` and `GeoSlices.test.tsx` (ran, pass); `geo-slices.db.test.ts` (7 tests, ran on a real PostgreSQL and pass). Wiring the filter into `geoByArea` happens where the screen's API calls it.
- **Mentions:** [PR 751](#pr-751), [PR 753](#pr-753), [PR 689](S28.md#pr-689)

## PR 757

**Geography map: courier and coverage lens (S29; parked; CN-054; Size M; depends on 756) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপ: এলাকা ধরে কুরিয়ারের সফলতা, ডেলিভারির সময়, সেরা কুরিয়ার, আর যে এলাকায় কুরিয়ার নেই। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: courier and coverage lens** (S29; **parked**; CN-054; Size M; depends on 756) — per area: courier success rate, delivery time against the band's promise, the best courier by area from the shop's own parcels (advice only: it never changes the courier rules), and **coverage gaps** (areas that have orders or visits but no courier mapped, from `CourierAreaMapping`). Off as shipped (`reports.geoMap.lenses.courier`); sources are the delivery and courier figures of PR 192 and 525, read only. Guide and screen words in the same PR. No migration.
- **Filed under:** [S29 · Geography map (Reports) — PR 750–761 (parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked): **Updated 16 Nov 2026 (coded, local branch `claude/geo-2`, NOT pushed, status stays parked until the owner says):** `packages/metrics/src/geo-courier.ts` (`courierLens`, `buildCourierLens`): per place of the chosen level, from the shop's own parcels only: courier success = delivered ÷ (delivered + returned) on each parcel's own day, delivery hours from pick-up (else booking) to delivery against the delivery band's promised hours (the late share counts only parcels whose band promised a time), the courier used most and the best courier there (advice only, among couriers with at least `minParcels` settled parcels), and flags (few parcels, low delivery rate, often late, no courier, another courier does better). Coverage: a place is covered by an enabled courier with a live (not archived) mapping on it or on a place above it; the list "Orders with no courier" names places with orders and no cover, most orders first (orders only: visits are not stored per area), orders without any area counted apart. Practice (MOCK) parcels, exchange legs, archived orders and other stores are never counted. Setting `reports.geoMapCourier` (registry version 805, store scope, `packages/settings/src/registry-geo-map-courier.ts`, words in `geo-map-courier.{en,bn}.json`): `minParcels`, `lowSuccessPct`, `lateWarnPct`, `gapLimit`, all editable and bounded; the lens itself is switched on in `reports.geoMap.lenses.courier`. API `GET /api/admin/reports/geo-map/lens` (`reports.read`, store-checked, refused when the courier lens is off, read-only; `lib/geo-map/lens-route.ts`), screen part `GeoCourierLens.tsx` and words `admin-geo-lens.{en,bn}.json`. Nothing here changes a courier rule, a booking or a mapping. Tests: `geo-courier.test.ts`, `GeoCourierLens.test.tsx`, `lens-route.test.ts`, `registry-geo-map-courier.test.ts` (ran, pass); `geo-courier.db.test.ts` (5 tests, ran on a real PostgreSQL and pass).
- **Mentions:** [PR 192](S08.md#pr-192), [PR 525](S08.md#pr-525)
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s29--geography-map-reports--parked) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 758

**Geography map: risk lens (S29; parked; CN-054; Size M; depends on 756) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপ: ফেরত আর COD রিফিউজের হটস্পট, বাতিলের কারণ, ফ্রড ঝুঁকির এলাকা, ক্লেইম আর সাপোর্ট। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: risk lens** (S29; **parked**; CN-054; Size M; depends on 756) — per area: return hotspots, COD refusals at the door (not the shop's fault, as PR 192 counts them), cancelled orders and their reasons, fraud and risk areas (from the fraud engine's own records, PR 156–164), and claims and support tickets per area (S22, S08 claims). Hotspot = at least `minOrders` settled orders and a rate over `warnReturnPct`; both numbers are settings. Counts only, no customer names or phones. Off as shipped (`reports.geoMap.lenses.risk`); each part needs the permission of its own source report. Guide in the same PR. No migration.
- **Filed under:** [S29 · Geography map (Reports) — PR 750–761 (parked)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s29--geography-map-reports--pr-750761-parked): **Updated 16 Nov 2026 (coded, local branch `claude/geo-3`, NOT pushed, status stays parked until the owner says):** `geoRisk` in `@extas/metrics` (`geo-risk.ts`) on the roll-up the three lenses share (`geo-lens-base.ts`: an order's area goes to its division, district, upazila/thana or Dhaka-City area, under a drill-down parent, with unknown and outside counted apart, parts adding up to the total); per area: delivered, returned, return rate and the flag `returnHotspot` (at least `minOrders` settled orders and a rate over `warnReturnPct`, both from `reports.geoMap`), refusals at the door as PR 192 counts them (`refusedAtDoor`, the customer's; `refusedOurFault` apart), cancelled orders with their reasons, orders the risk score put in its top band (`risk.bands`, the last band) with the flag `riskArea`, courier claims and support tickets (put in their order's area; a ticket with no order counted apart). Each part is read only when the viewer holds the permission of its own source report (`reports.read`, `delivery.read`, `risk.report`, `delivery.claims`, `support.read`); a part left out is `null` and named in `hidden`. `GET /api/admin/reports/geo-map/lens?lens=risk` (`lib/geo-map/lens-api.ts`) answers `not_on` while `reports.geoMap.on` or `reports.geoMap.lenses.risk` is off (both off as shipped) and reads nothing; `lib/geo-map/setting.ts` reads the setting defensively (missing or odd reads as off). Counts only; nothing blocks, holds or changes an order, a COD rule, a courier or a customer. Guide: `docs/admin-guide/pages/reports/geo-map-lenses.md`. Tests: pure (hotspot edges, refusals, reasons, risk area, hidden parts, drill-down; ran) and PostgreSQL (written, not run: no database on this machine). No migration.
- **Mentions:** [PR 192](S08.md#pr-192), [PR 156](S06.md#pr-156), [PR 157](S06.md#pr-157), [PR 158](S06.md#pr-158), [PR 159](S06.md#pr-159), [PR 160](S06.md#pr-160), [PR 161](S06.md#pr-161), [PR 162](S06.md#pr-162), [PR 163](S06.md#pr-163), [PR 164](S06.md#pr-164)

## PR 761

**Geography map: AI advisor (S29; parked; CN-054; Size M; depends on 757–760, 733) —**

**বাংলায়:** জিওগ্রাফি ম্যাপের AI পরামর্শদাতা: কোথায় বিজ্ঞাপন, কোথায় COD বন্ধ, কোন কুরিয়ার, কোন পণ্য। শুধু পরামর্শ, অনুমোদন লাগে, নিজে কিছু বদলায় না। পার্ক করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Parked (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Geography map: AI advisor** (S29; **parked**; CN-054; Size M; depends on 757–760, 733) — the AI reads the map's figures (with the lenses that are on) and suggests actions: where to advertise more or less, where to stop COD or ask for an advance, which courier per area, which product to push in which area, stock to place, delivery-charge or free-delivery ideas, coverage to add. **Advice only:** each suggestion is a draft in the existing approval queue with the numbers behind it; the AI never changes an ad budget, a campaign, a price, a charge, a COD rule or a courier by itself (hard rule 6), and it runs only while `ai.enabled` is on (off as shipped; with AI off the map works without it). The ad-platform lists ("more" and "less" districts) are made exactly like Where to advertise (PR 569), to copy by hand. Its own switch `reports.geoMap.ai` (off), a monthly cap on AI cost from the AI cost settings, the AI answers in the language the owner writes. Tests for: AI off means no call and no draft; nothing in the queue changes live data. Guide in the same PR. No migration.
